processing_notes: Source states: 'Three districts-Mangochi, Lilongwe and Blantyre-accounted for nearly 50 per cent of the total cholera cases in the country, recording more than 29,600 out of almost 57,600 cases, and over 52 per cent of the total deaths (899), as of 12 April.
